arch.input: one channel, 64x64, pixel value divided by 255, no mean subtraction
arch.order: for each layer: conv2d with padding 1 (the head 1x1) then bias, then ReLU except on the head, with a 2x2 max pool of stride 2 after each layer listed in pool_after
arch.channel_layout: head channel a*(5+C)+t, t = 0..3 box, 4 objectness, 5..9 class logits
arch.decode: x=(col+sigmoid(t0))*stride, y=(row+sigmoid(t1))*stride, w=anchor_w*exp(clamp(t2,-4,4)), h=anchor_h*exp(clamp(t3,-4,4)), corners x-w/2, y-h/2, x+w/2, y+h/2, then every coordinate clamped to [0, 64]

errors.note: the reference boxes below were computed in float64 with the quantised weights, so quantisation cannot appear in the browser's printed agreement; what remains is dtype alone

pixel_check.note: the browser must read exactly these integers out of the sprite before anything downstream can be believed
